goal: Look up member 100045 and read their current savings balance and account name.

rationale: The Member Enquiry panel has a Member Number field, which is where a lookup starts.
Find submits the member enquiry; the other two buttons are both called Search and belong to other panels.
The search returned a result row rather than the member page, and the row is a link named after the member number.
Savings Balance is a row header and the value sits in the cell beside it.
Account Name confirms the right membership was opened, so the caller can check it against the request.
The member detail screen is open and both requested values have been read.
